tests: A form drawn entirely with borders and labels — no real form fields exist in the PDF. Six labelled entry boxes and a four-option checkbox row.
attacks: The gap between what a document looks like and what it is. There are no widget annotations, so nothing here can become an accessible form field by tagging alone; the honest outcome is that the labels are content, the boxes are graphics, and the document is reported as needing human work. Inventing form semantics is an assertion. Equally, artifacting the empty boxes silently deletes the fact that anything is fillable.
title: Incident Report Form

formFields.label: Degree of harm
formFields.control: four drawn squares labelled None, Low, Moderate, Severe

expectedOutcome: No real form fields exist, so this cannot reach DELIVERABLE by tagging. Correct results are NEEDS_REVIEW or INCONCLUSIVE naming the form as unaddressable.
decorativeGraphics: field boxes and checkbox squares are graphics, not content
intentionalProblems: a form with no form fields
empty boxes carrying meaning by position
